winning_patterns.pattern: Both account purchases came from creatives WITHOUT discount overlays: an emotional gift narrative (LD-CN-GIFT-MOMENT) and an authentic product spread (LD-CN-PRODUCT-SPREAD).

failed_patterns.pattern: LD-CN-CATALOG-GRID + 25% discount: $364.86 (22% of account spend), 0 reported purchases. Discount-led breadth message is the account's largest unconverted spend block.
LD-CN-CITY-PRIDE (Nashville static + UGC): $287.28 combined, 0 reported purchases across two formats.
Copy fragmentation: 15-29 text variants per ad splits already-thin spend below any isolation threshold.

active_hypotheses.hypothesis: Emotional gift-moment narrative (HK_Story/Shock + TN_Emotional + precisely-named street) outconverts offer-led catalog creative for cold traffic.
Two buyer paths exist: young gift buyers (25-34) respond to recipient-story creative; 55+ self-decorators respond to authentic product spreads. Split messaging by ICP.
Geo-specific city pride works only when geo-targeted tightly; broad delivery wastes it.

evidence_notes: All performance evidence in this library is from a 2-purchase, $1,651.69 window with mixed attribution (61% Incremental). Nothing here is proven. Treat every code's performance annotation as validation_required until re-exported data with funnel columns and consistent attribution is analyzed.

Uploaded asset set differs slightly from the strict top-10 by spend: '3 Prints on bed' ($49.85) and 'Avatar - Gift 3' ($42.98) outspent '2 Print Static' ($22.83) and '2 Print + Dads Gift' ($11.62) but were not uploaded.
